fact: OPais reports that on 30 July 2026 the Assembleia Nacional unanimously (166 votes in favour) approved the bill authorising the President to legislate the Regime Jurídico da Assinatura Electrónica e da Certificação Digital, valid for 90 days after publication; the regime itself is not yet enacted.

fact: Angop reports that on 30 July 2026 the Assembleia Nacional approved in generalidade, by 166 votes to none, the request for legislative authorisation for the President to legislate the Regime Jurídico da Assinatura Electrónica e da Certificação Digital, which would set e-signature validity, evidential value and the ICP-Angola; the regime is not yet enacted.

fact: Presidential Decree 202/11, published in Diario da Republica I Serie no. 139 on 22 July 2011, approves Angola's Regulation on Information Society Technologies and Services, which covers information society services, electronic documents and legal acts (qualified electronic signature, certification, electronic contracts) and electronic advertising, and enters into force 30 days after publication; the excerpt held is truncated before the signature and contract articles.
